match.userMessage: Storyboard animatic frame. wide. eye level. Handheld observational view of the bakery entrance and street; MARA is framed by the doorway, with the opposite side of the road visible. MARA stands at the bakery entrance beside the shop sign, ready to turn it; CYCLIST is not yet in frame. Then: She stops mid-motion and listens to the street. Camera: handheld follow, natural, lightly responsive. Hold the street's distance between them as the greeting carries across. Characters: CYCLIST, Unspecified, 20s–40s, A delivery cyclist seen across the road, A practical dark cycling jacket, fitted trousers. MARA, Female, 30s, A woman in her 30s, of average height, A white cotton baker’s shirt, a flour-dusted natural-canvas. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, correct perspective and depth, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Figures have readable poses, gestures and simple expressive faces. Draw the single opening moment of the shot: each character appears exactly once, and what happens next is shown only by a few bold arrows for the camera move and the way subjects travel. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
